title: FT8 Grid Reach After Sunset
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ft8:spot
| search mode=FT8 hour_local>=18
| stats count as spots, dc(dx_call) as dx_stations by grid
| sort 0 - spots,
description: Ranks grid squaress by after-dark FT8 spots.
value: Evening grid reach is a practical check on when the station is most effective for casual DX.
implementation: Send after-dark FT8 spots events to `index=personal` and keep `grid` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of after-dark FT8 spots by grid squares.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which grid squaress stand out most for after-dark FT8 spots.
